notes:
Summary:
- E-commerce native marketplace, ~8M SKUs across NA/EU catalogs. Heavy seasonal variance (peak multipliers 4-6x; Black Friday 8-10x for category search).
- Primary initiative: replace legacy keyword search + heuristics with semantic nearest-neighbor search + learned reranker. Focus KPI = cost-per-query (target <$0.005 on average; must stay < $0.02 at peak) and p50/p95 latency for search+rerank combined (target p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms).
- Proposed architecture discussed: Redwood embeddings endpoint -> vector index (managed or customer-hosted) -> fast candidate retrieval -> Redwood-hosted reranker (or on Dedicated pool) for final scoring and business-rule blending.
- Indexing & scale notes: target index ~8M vectors, nightly refresh incremental sync, approx 1.2M updates/month (price/availability changes). Concern about memory/replication on Dedicated.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO wants three scenarios: (1) hosted API w/ caching for steady traffic, (2) Dedicated reserved capacity + burst credits for seasonal peaks, (3) Private (VPC) with self-hosted vector DB for strict residency - compare TCO.
- Security: Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for encryption at rest, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for EU catalog subset.
- Technical preferences: prefer 768-dim embeddings for current models, open to quantized model variants to reduce footprint. Reranker must support feature injection (merchant rules, margin signals).
- Quote from Rahul (Head of Search): "We need a predictable price per query during holiday or we won't be able to commit to a full rollout."
- Integrations: ERP feed (via SFTP), product taxonomy service, merch experimentation A/B platform. Need webhook/SDK support for A/B hooks.
- POC ask: index 250k seed SKUs + 10 curated queries -> measure recall@10, rerank precision, end-to-end latency, and cost-per-query baseline. If POC meets targets then expand to 1M and then full catalog.
- Success metrics: recall@10 > 0.82 vs baseline, rerank click-through lift +6-12%, end-to-end cost per query within target band.
- Operational ask: want visibility into token-level cost, per-route latency, and per-model cost breakdown in Console. Also want automatic fallback (cheaper model) under capacity pressure.
